# Evaluation {#sec-chapter5}

A ranking instrument earns its place in governance practice only if its outputs survive scrutiny. This chapter puts the framework under two forms of pressure: it tests whether rankings shift when criterion weights change, and whether the scores produced align with independent operational evidence that was not used to construct them.
